git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(spec): correct 7 review findings in mission lifecycle spec

Code review fix round on docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex (line
numbers at commit 972ee18):

1. SUBSTANTIVE -- Store.Update (store.go:873-932) has no
   status = stOpen guard and Contract.Validate accepts all five
   statuses, so Update can rewrite a closed contract's status back to
   open. The spec wrongly listed Update among the seven guarded
   functions (naming seven, citing six ranges). Removed it from that
   list, disclosed the real-code gap explicitly (filed as bead
   ethos-fhns; fix lands separately, no Go touched here), and
   restated TerminalIsFinal as holding over the modelled operation
   set, narrower than "nothing in the real Store can move it again."
2. BUILD -- \emptyset inside \field{} (text mode) breaks pdflatex;
   moved it outside into math mode.
3. BUILD -- bare \Xi in a tabularx cell; wrapped as $\Xi \field{Mission}$
   matching every other occurrence in the document.
4. CONTRADICTION -- Idle's subsection claimed "every operation above
   except DelegateAborted guards on status = stOpen," but
   DelegateAborted's only predicate is status = stOpen. Deleted the
   false exception.
5. RECORD -- the AdvanceRound-coverage-gap paragraph claimed
   state-for-state AND transition-for-transition identity with the
   pre-rebaseline run; transitions differ by the 240 the two new
   DES-076 operations contribute over the same 373 states. Narrowed
   to state-for-state, with the transition delta explained.
6. CITE -- PR #517 was cited as touching validate.go; it touched
   result.go (Result.Validate, result.go:178), not validate.go.
7. CITE -- CloseDelegationSkeleton cited as delegation.go:649-726;
   726 is DisclaimDelegationRecord's start. Fixed to 649-692.

Verified: fuzz 0 errors, ProB model_check unchanged (373 states, 989
transitions, matching the Tool run table), pdflatex -halt-on-error
compiles cleanly to PDF (two passes, no undefined references), make
check green. Only docs/spec-mission-lifecycle.tex touched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)"

tool_input.content:
\documentclass[a4paper,10pt,fleqn]{article}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{fuzz}
\begin{document}

\begin{zed}
ZBOOL ::= ztrue | zfalse
\end{zed}

\begin{zed}
SEG ::= segDocs | segFile
\end{zed}

\begin{zed}
PATSEG ::= litSeg \ldata SEG \rdata | wildRestSeg
\end{zed}

\begin{axdef}
maxSegs : \nat
\where
maxSegs = 2
\end{axdef}

\begin{axdef}
maxOpen : \nat
\where
maxOpen = 2
\end{axdef}

\begin{schema}{ENTRY}
isDir, isEI : ZBOOL \\
pattern : \seq PATSEG \\
rootGlob : ZBOOL \\
truncLen : \nat \\
seg1, seg2 : PATSEG
\where
\# pattern \leq maxSegs \\
isEI = ztrue \implies isDir = ztrue \\
\forall i : 1 \upto \# pattern @ pattern(i) = wildRestSeg \implies i = \# pattern \\
rootGlob = (\IF \# pattern = 1 \land pattern(1) = wildRestSeg \THEN ztrue \ELSE zfalse) \\
truncLen = (\IF \# pattern > 0 \land pattern(\# pattern) = wildRestSeg
             \THEN \# pattern - 1 \ELSE \# pattern) \\
truncLen \geq 1 \implies seg1 = pattern(1) \\
truncLen \geq 2 \implies seg2 = pattern(2)
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{Store}
open : 1 \upto maxOpen \pfun ENTRY
\where
\forall i, j : \dom open | i \neq j @
  \lnot ( \lnot ((open\ i).isEI = ztrue \land (open\ j).isEI = ztrue) \land
    ( ( (open\ i).isDir = (open\ j).isDir \land
        \lnot ( ((open\ i).truncLen = 0 \land (open\ i).rootGlob = zfalse)
                \lor ((open\ j).truncLen = 0 \land (open\ j).rootGlob = zfalse) ) \land
        ( (open\ i).rootGlob = ztrue \lor (open\ j).rootGlob = ztrue
          \lor ( (open\ i).seg1 = (open\ j).seg1 \land
                ( (open\ i).truncLen = 1 \lor (open\ j).truncLen = 1
                  \lor (open\ i).seg2 = (open\ j).seg2 ) ) ) )
      \lor ( (open\ i).isDir = zfalse \land (open\ j).isDir = ztrue \land
        (open\ j).truncLen \leq (open\ i).truncLen \land
        ( (open\ j).truncLen \geq 1 \implies (open\ j).seg1 = (open\ i).seg1 ) \land
        ( (open\ j).truncLen \geq 2 \implies (open\ j).seg2 = (open\ i).seg2 ) )
      \lor ( (open\ j).isDir = zfalse \land (open\ i).isDir = ztrue \land
        (open\ i).truncLen \leq (open\ j).truncLen \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 1 \implies (open\ i).seg1 = (open\ j).seg1 ) \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 2 \implies (open\ i).seg2 = (open\ j).seg2 ) ) ) )
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{Init}
Store'
\where
open' = \emptyset
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{AdmitMission}
\Delta Store \\
slot? : 1 \upto maxOpen \\
entry? : ENTRY
\where
slot? \notin \dom open \\
\forall i : \dom open @
  \lnot ( \lnot (entry?.isEI = ztrue \land (open\ i).isEI = ztrue) \land
    ( (entry?.isDir = (open\ i).isDir \land
        \lnot ( (entry?.truncLen = 0 \land entry?.rootGlob = zfalse)
                \lor ((open\ i).truncLen = 0 \land (open\ i).rootGlob = zfalse) ) \land
        ( entry?.rootGlob = ztrue \lor (open\ i).rootGlob = ztrue
          \lor ( entry?.seg1 = (open\ i).seg1 \land
                ( entry?.truncLen = 1 \lor (open\ i).truncLen = 1
                  \lor entry?.seg2 = (open\ i).seg2 ) ) ) )
      \lor (entry?.isDir = zfalse \land (open\ i).isDir = ztrue \land
        (open\ i).truncLen \leq entry?.truncLen \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 1 \implies (open\ i).seg1 = entry?.seg1 ) \land
        ( (open\ i).truncLen \geq 2 \implies (open\ i).seg2 = entry?.seg2 ) )
      \lor ((open\ i).isDir = zfalse \land entry?.isDir = ztrue \land
        entry?.truncLen \leq (open\ i).truncLen \land
        ( entry?.truncLen \geq 1 \implies entry?.seg1 = (open\ i).seg1 ) \land
        ( entry?.truncLen \geq 2 \implies entry?.seg2 = (open\ i).seg2 ) ) ) ) \\
open' = open \oplus \{ slot? \mapsto entry? \}
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{ReleaseMission}
\Delta Store \\
slot? : 1 \upto maxOpen
\where
slot? \in \dom open \\
open' = \{ slot? \} \ndres open
\end{schema}

\end{document}
